```{r name list}
all_species <- c("col0", "ost0", "aspen", "birch", "spruce", "pine") 
combo <- data.frame(t(combn(all_species, 2)))

```

NB !! Change path and name of transcription files once new ones are ready - here manually imputed files were used for heatmaps.
```{r file names}
# List of file names.
file_list_1 <- c()
for (i in 1:nrow(combo)){
  
  s1 <- combo[i, "X1"]
  s2 <- combo[i, "X2"]
  
  file_name <- paste0("data/ComPlEx/PairwiseComparisons/comparison-",s1,"-",s2,"-abspearsonMR0.03-table.RData")
  file_list_1 <- append(file_list_1, file_name, after = length(file_list_1))
  }

file_list_2 <- c()
for (i in all_species){
  expr_name <- paste0("data/expression/",i,"_root_cold_stress_expression.txt")
  file_list_2 <- append(file_list_2, expr_name, after = length(file_list_2))
}

```

# Heatmaps
## Correlation matrices
```{r corr matrix}
pval <- 0.1

for (x in file_list_1) {
  if (file.exists(x)) {
    # Load the data from file_list_1
    load(x)

    # Extract co-expressologs and filter by p-value
    co_expressologs <- comparison_table %>%
      select(Species1, Species2, OrthoGroup, Max.p.val) %>%
      mutate_at("Max.p.val", as.numeric) %>%
      filter(Max.p.val < pval) %>%
      ungroup() %>%
      arrange(Max.p.val) %>%
      distinct(Species1, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
      distinct(Species2, .keep_all = TRUE)

    # Extract key words for species 1 and species 2 from the file name
    key_word_s1 <- sapply(strsplit(x, "-"), "[", 3)
    key_word_s2 <- sapply(strsplit(x, "-"), "[", 4)

    # SPECIES 1: Find corresponding file in file_list_2 for species 1
    for (i in file_list_2) {
      if (grepl(key_word_s1, i)) {
        expr_data <- read.delim(i) # Read expression file

        # Extract expression data for species 1
        s1_expression <- co_expressologs %>%
          left_join(expr_data, join_by(Species1 == Genes)) %>%
          select(-c("Species2", "Max.p.val", "OrthoGroup")) %>%
          as_tibble() %>%
          column_to_rownames(var = "Species1") %>%
          select(contains("1."))

        s1_expression[is.na(s1_expression)] <- 0
      }
    }

    # SPECIES 2: Find corresponding file in file_list_2 for species 2
    for (i in file_list_2) {
      if (grepl(key_word_s2, i)) {
        expr_data <- read.delim(i) # Read expression file

        # Extract expression data for species 2
        s2_expression <- co_expressologs %>%
          left_join(expr_data, join_by(Species2 == Genes)) %>%
          select(-c("Species1", "Max.p.val", "OrthoGroup")) %>%
          as_tibble() %>%
          column_to_rownames(var = "Species2") %>%
          select(contains("1."))

        s2_expression[is.na(s2_expression)] <- 0
      }
    }

    # Skip correlation if both species are the same (no point in comparing identical species)
    if (key_word_s1 == key_word_s2) {
      next
    }

    # Correlation matrix calculation
    if (ncol(s1_expression) > 0 && ncol(s2_expression) > 0) {
      corr_matrix <- round(cor(s1_expression, s2_expression, method = "pearson"), 4)

      # Save the correlation matrix with a unique name
      new_name <- as.character(paste0("corr_", key_word_s1, "-", key_word_s2))
      mv("corr_matrix", new_name)
    } else {
      warning(paste("No expression data for comparison between", key_word_s1, "and", key_word_s2))
    }
  }
}

########################################################################################################################
for (x in file_list_1) {
  if (file.exists(x)) {
    # Load the data from file_list_1
    load(x)

    # Extract co-expressologs and filter by p-value
    co_expressologs <- comparison_table %>%
      select(Species1, Species2, OrthoGroup, Max.p.val) %>%
      mutate_at("Max.p.val", as.numeric) %>%
      filter(Max.p.val < pval) %>%
      ungroup() %>%
      arrange(Max.p.val) %>%
      distinct(Species1, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
      distinct(Species2, .keep_all = TRUE)

    # Extract key words for species 1 and species 2 from the file name
    key_word_s1 <- sapply(strsplit(x, "-"), "[", 3)
    key_word_s2 <- sapply(strsplit(x, "-"), "[", 4)

    # Initialize combined data frames
    s1_combined <- data.frame()
    s2_combined <- data.frame()

    # SPECIES 1: Find corresponding file in file_list_2 for species 1
    for (i in file_list_2) {
      if (grepl(key_word_s1, i)) {
        expr_data <- read.delim(i)  # Read expression file

        # Extract expression data for species 1
        s1_expression <- co_expressologs %>%
          left_join(expr_data, join_by(Species1 == Genes)) %>%
          select(-c("Species2", "Max.p.val", "OrthoGroup")) %>%
          as_tibble() %>%
          column_to_rownames(var = "Species1") %>%
          select(contains("1."))

        s1_expression[is.na(s1_expression)] <- 0
        
        # Pivot longer and summarize
        s1_expression_long <- s1_expression %>%
          pivot_longer(cols = everything(), 
                       names_to = c("Replicate", "Treatment"), 
                       names_sep = "\\.", 
                       values_to = "Expression")

        s1_combined <- s1_expression_long %>%
          group_by(Treatment) %>%
          summarize(Expression = mean(Expression, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
          mutate(Species = key_word_s1);  # Add species identifier
      }
    }

    # SPECIES 2: Find corresponding file in file_list_2 for species 2
    for (i in file_list_2) {
      if (grepl(key_word_s2, i)) {
        expr_data <- read.delim(i)  # Read expression file

        # Extract expression data for species 2
        s2_expression <- co_expressologs %>%
          left_join(expr_data, join_by(Species2 == Genes)) %>%
          select(-c("Species1", "Max.p.val", "OrthoGroup")) %>%
          as_tibble() %>%
          column_to_rownames(var = "Species2") %>%
          select(contains("1."))

        s2_expression[is.na(s2_expression)] <- 0;
        
        # Pivot longer and summarize
        s2_expression_long <- s2_expression %>%
          pivot_longer(cols = everything(), 
                       names_to = c("Replicate", "Treatment"), 
                       names_sep = "\\.", 
                       values_to = "Expression")

        s2_combined <- s2_expression_long %>%
          group_by(Treatment) %>%
          summarize(Expression = mean(Expression, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
          mutate(Species = key_word_s2);  # Add species identifier
      }
    }

    # Skip correlation if both species are the same (no point in comparing identical species)
    if (key_word_s1 == key_word_s2) {
      next
    }

    # Correlation matrix calculation
    if (nrow(s1_combined) > 0 && nrow(s2_combined) > 0) {
      # Check if Treatment exists in both combined data frames
      if ("Treatment" %in% colnames(s1_combined) && "Treatment" %in% colnames(s2_combined)) {
        # Join combined data for correlation calculation
        combined_data <- full_join(s1_combined, s2_combined, by = "Treatment", suffix = c("_S1", "_S2"))

        # Ensure there are values to correlate
        if (nrow(combined_data) > 0 && all(c("Expression_S1", "Expression_S2") %in% colnames(combined_data))) {
          corr_matrix <- round(cor(combined_data[, c("Expression_S1", "Expression_S2")], method = "pearson"), 4)

          # Save the correlation matrix with a unique name
          new_name <- as.character(paste0("corr_", key_word_s1, "-", key_word_s2))
          mv("corr_matrix", new_name)
        } else {
          warning(paste("No valid expression data for correlation between", key_word_s1, "and", key_word_s2))
        }
      } else {
        warning("Treatment column is missing in one of the combined data frames.")
      }
    } else {
      warning(paste("No expression data for comparison between", key_word_s1, "and", key_word_s2))
    }
  }
}

# Self-correlation matrices
load("data/ComPlEx/all_expressed_genes.RData")
co_expressologs_all <- expr_genes %>% 
  filter(Max.p.Val < 0.1)

for(i in file_list_2){
  # i <- file_list_2[2]
  
  species <- sapply(strsplit(i, "expression/"), "[",2)
  species <- sapply(strsplit(species, "_root_cold_stress_expression.txt"), "[",1)
  print(species)
  
  co_expressologs_one_species <- co_expressologs_all %>% 
    filter(species %in% Species1 | species %in% Species2)
  
  col_1 <-co_expressologs_one_species %>% 
    select(Species1, GeneSpecies1) %>% 
    rename(Species = "Species1", Genes = "GeneSpecies1") %>% 
    filter(Species == species)
  
  col_2 <-co_expressologs_one_species %>% 
    select(Species2, GeneSpecies2) %>% 
    rename(Species = "Species2", Genes = "GeneSpecies2")%>% 
    filter(Species == species)
  
  if(nrow(col_1) == 0) {
    combined_df <- col_2
  }
  
  if(nrow(col_2) == 0) {
    combined_df <- col_1
  }

  if(nrow(col_2) > 0 & nrow(col_1) > 0){
    combined_df <- rbind(col_1, col_2)
  }
  
  combined_df <- combined_df %>% 
    distinct(Genes, .keep_all = T)
    
  expression <- read.delim(i) %>%
    filter(Genes %in% combined_df$Genes) %>% 
    select(contains("1."))

  corr_matrix <- round(cor(expression[,-1], method = "pearson"), 4)
  new_name <- as.character(paste0("corr_",species, "-",species))
  mv("corr_matrix", new_name) # rename the heatmaps for plotting in grid.
}
```

## Density plots
```{r }
df_for_density <- c()
for(matrix in corr_list){
  # matrix <- corr_list[2]
  
  pair <- sapply(strsplit(matrix, "_"), "[",2)
  correlation_vect <- c(get(matrix))
  
  df <- data.frame(
    pair = rep(pair, length(correlation_vect)),
    correlation_values = correlation_vect
  )
  
  df_for_density <- rbind(df_for_density, df)
  # print(paste0(pair, ": ", length(correlation_vect)))
}
```

```{r}
# Plotting comparison heatmaps with phylogenetic trees
```
